nodes.description: Owned.owner: address of the contract owner, set to msg.sender at deployment.
Owned.newOwner: pending owner used in two-step ownership transfer.
AlbinoInu.symbol = 'ALBINU'.
AlbinoInu.name = 'AlbinoInu'.
AlbinoInu.decimals = 18.
AlbinoInu._totalSupply: total token supply minted in constructor.
mapping(address => uint) balances: token balances.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) allowed: ERC20 allowances.
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b): checked addition.
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b): checked subtraction.
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b): checked multiplication.
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b): checked division.
Owned constructor: sets owner = msg.sender.
Owned.transferOwnership(address _newOwner): onlyOwner, sets pending newOwner.
Owned.acceptOwnership(): pending owner claims ownership.
AlbinoInu constructor: sets metadata, mints total supply to a fixed address.
totalSupply(): returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)].
balanceOf(address tokenOwner): returns balances[tokenOwner].
transfer(address to, uint tokens): moves tokens from msg.sender.
approve(address spender, uint tokens): sets allowance for msg.sender.
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens): spends allowance and moves tokens.
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender): returns allowed mapping value.
approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data): approves then invokes spender callback.
payable fallback function that always reverts (rejects ETH).
transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens): onlyOwner rescue of arbitrary ERC20.
ApproveAndCallFallBack.receiveApproval: external contract callback invoked by approveAndCall.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for ownership, balances and allowances.
Addition c = a + b in safeAdd with post-condition require(c >= a).
Subtraction c = a - b in safeSub with pre-condition require(b <= a).
Multiplication c = a * b in safeMul with overflow check.
Division c = a / b in safeDiv with require(b > 0).
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) on an attacker-supplied spender contract.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an arbitrary token contract.
Parameter 'to' of transfer().
Parameter 'tokens' of transfer().
Parameter 'spender' of approve().
Parameter 'tokens' of approve().
Parameter 'from' of transferFrom().
Parameter 'to' of transferFrom().
Parameter 'tokens' of transferFrom().
Parameter 'spender' of approveAndCall(); also the callback target contract.
Parameter 'tokens' of approveAndCall().
Parameter 'data' of approveAndCall(), forwarded to the callback.
Parameter '_newOwner' of transferOwnership().
Parameter 'tokenAddress' of transferAnyERC20Token(), used as external call target.
Parameter 'tokens' of transferAnyERC20Token().
Local return variable 'c' holding a + b in safeAdd.
Local return variable 'c' holding a - b in safeSub.
Local return variable 'c' holding a * b in safeMul.
Local return variable 'c' holding a / b in safeDiv.
External ERC20 transfer entry point reached via ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens).

edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns owner from msg.sender, establishing caller-controlled privileged role.
transferOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier which compares msg.sender with owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before transferring ownership.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] using the caller-supplied address.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] using the caller address.
transferFrom spends allowed[from][msg.sender] using the caller address.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and forwards msg.sender to the callback.
Constructor writes msg.sender into the owner state variable.
transferOwnership stores the new owner candidate into newOwner.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into owner.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner after the ownership handoff.
Constructor initializes the symbol state variable.
Constructor initializes the name state variable.
Constructor initializes the decimals state variable.
Constructor sets _totalSupply to the fixed initial supply.
Constructor mints the whole supply into balances of the fixed address.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
balanceOf returns a value from the balances mapping.
allowance returns a value from the allowed mapping.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping for sender and recipient.
transfer computes the sender balance with safeSub.
transfer computes the recipient balance with safeAdd.
approve writes the allowance into the allowed mapping.
transferFrom updates balances of the from and to accounts.
transferFrom decrements the allowed allowance of msg.sender.
transferFrom uses safeSub for balance and allowance deductions.
transferFrom uses safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
approveAndCall writes the allowance before performing the external call.
approveAndCall unconditionally executes an external call to the spender supplied by the caller.
Owner-only rescue function performs an external call on an arbitrary token address.
safeAdd performs the raw addition guarded by an overflow require.
safeSub performs the raw subtraction guarded by require(b <= a).
safeMul performs the raw multiplication guarded by an overflow require.
safeDiv performs the raw division guarded by require(b > 0).
External call invokes receiveApproval on the caller-controlled spender contract, allowing reentering the token.
External call executes transfer on the arbitrary token contract, whose code can reenter the caller.
Recipient parameter feeds the transfer credit path.
Amount parameter feeds the transfer debit and credit paths.
Spender parameter indexes the allowance entry written by approve.
Amount parameter is stored as the approved allowance.
From parameter selects the debited balance and allowance row.
To parameter selects the credited balance.
Amount parameter feeds the safeSub and safeAdd calls in transferFrom.
Spender parameter is both the allowance key and the target contract of the external call.
Amount parameter is granted as allowance and forwarded to the callback.
Data parameter is forwarded verbatim into the external receiveApproval call.
New owner candidate parameter is stored for the pending ownership handoff.
Token address parameter becomes the target of the external ERC20 transfer call.
Amount parameter is forwarded to the external ERC20 transfer call.
Local result c is the output of the addition operation in safeAdd.
Local result c is the output of the subtraction operation in safeSub.
Local result c is the output of the multiplication operation in safeMul.
Local result c is the output of the division operation in safeDiv.
onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership on the owner state variable before execution.
onlyOwner modifier gates transferAnyERC20Token and the owner address is passed to the external call.
